title: Grand Theft Auto VI
extract: Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set in the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they lead a life of crime to escape from corrupt police officers. The game's open world nature allows players to freely roam Leonida and its Miami-inspired Vice City and engage in various side activities.
